response.sql: WITH budget_stats AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) as avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) as overall_average FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL) SELECT budget_stats.event_status, budget_stats.avg_remaining, budget_stats.avg_remaining - overall_avg.overall_average as difference FROM budget_stats CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE overall_avg.overall_average IS NOT NULL
